Source correspondence — generated public candidate

Share GODENplayer-corresponding-sources.zip beside the installer. The ZIP
contains effective GODENplayer source, the modified Columns UI 3.6.0 source
and submodules, Spectrum upstream plus all 18 patches and effective headers,
SDK/WTL/vcpkg sources, licenses and build recipes. No private Git history or
personal profiles are included.

GODEN-RELEASE-MANIFEST.json records the current canonical version and six
managed runtime binary hashes, source fingerprint and dependency-lock hash.
GODEN-PAYLOAD-MANIFEST.json and the installer build manifest bind this candidate
to the source ZIP hash. SOURCE-MANIFEST.json inside the ZIP records each file.
Historical component hashes are intentionally not copied into this notice.

goden-shader-render.exe is the independent Kerr-Newman image program. Its
GPL-covered combined program, retained GLSL, MIT frame protocol/client, native
renderer and offline build recipes are included in the corresponding sources.
See KERR-RENDERER-COPYING.md and LICENSES/NPGS-NOTICE.txt. Separate contribution
permissions remain pending; separation does not license those contributions.

foobar2000 remains proprietary and intact; the complete official 2.25.10 x64
installer is embedded unchanged and executed locally. No extracted portable
host is distributed. Playback Statistics 3.1.11 is downloaded separately from
its official source, verified by fixed package/x64 hashes, and not embedded.

The root MIT license covers original project work only. Consult LICENSE-SCOPE.md
and docs/SHADER-PROVENANCE.md for unresolved shader permissions and icon status.
